name: Stack
description:
Children one after another with an even gap from the spacing roles: fields in a form,
buttons in a row, panels on a page. It owns spacing so children need no margins.
signature: ({ as: Element, direction, gap, align, justify, wrap, className, style, children, ...rest }: StackProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment of the children. Default: stretch in a column, centre in a row.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children. Default `controls` in a row and `fields` in a column.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution of the children. Default: start.

props.name: role
props.description: An ARIA role when the container is a list, a group or a region.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style, merged after the layout's own variables.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let a row wrap onto more lines.
